Advanced Tech Availability Nuances
Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs):
Systems like FreeStyle Libre require prescriptions or specialized diabetes care channels in Sweden, though data can sometimes mirror to compatible smartwatches via external phone apps (like Garmin/Dexcom integration) rather than direct pharmacy hardware sales.

Wearable ECG & Remote Patient Monitoring:
Medical-grade ECG smartwatches (such as high-end Apple Watch or Withings models) or clinical remote patient monitoring gear are generally acquired through consumer electronics retailers or specialized medical distributors rather than standard local pharmacy storefronts.
